title: Biomarker delta across two dose arms with overlapping 95% CIs
what: small ~2.7 pg/mL mean difference between 150 mg (-21.1) and 50 mg (-18.4), inside overlapping 95% CIs

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: 150 mg averages -21.1 pg/mL vs 50 mg -18.4 pg/mL (a 2.7 pg/mL difference, no clear dose advantage).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: No; the 95% CIs (-28.6 to -13.6 vs -25.5 to -11.3 pg/mL) overlap extensively.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Both arms clearly reduce the biomarker below zero from baseline, but higher dose does not reliably add benefit over 50 mg.
